component.name: FlixDesk
component.summary: Unofficial Netflix desktop client for Linux with MPRIS and Widevine support

description.p: FlixDesk is a modern, feature-rich desktop client for Netflix designed specifically for Linux desktop environments such as Pop!_OS COSMIC, GNOME, and KDE.

Enjoy seamless desktop integration with native Linux media key controls (MPRIS), system tray support, auto-skipping of intros and recaps, 1080p stream unlocks, hardware-accelerated video decoding (VA-API), and Discord Rich Presence.

ul.li: Linux MPRIS D-Bus Integration: Control playback via keyboard media keys, GNOME top bar, and lock screen media widget.
Widevine DRM Support: Built-in discovery and loading for Google Widevine CDM.
1080p Stream Enabler: Bypasses default 720p throttles to request full 1080p AVC/H.264 video streams.
Smart Auto-Skip: Automatically skips opening intros, recap sequences, and automatically advances to next episodes.
Picture-in-Picture Mode: Watch shows in a resizable, floating window while working.
System Tray Integration: Quick controls and background playback status from your desktop panel.
Discord Rich Presence: Show your active movie or TV series on your Discord profile.
Hardware Acceleration: VA-API GPU decoding for smoother playback and reduced battery consumption.
Wayland and X11: Native support for modern Wayland compositors and standard X11 sessions.

description.p: Note: This application is an unofficial web wrapper for netflix.com and is NOT affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by Netflix, Inc.
Initial release of FlixDesk with MPRIS, Widevine DRM, 1080p unlock, system tray, and auto-skip capabilities.
